source_caption:
🎬 Beetlejuice Beetlejuice (2024)

Beetlejuice Beetlejuice follows Lydia Deetz, who returns to her childhood home in Winter River after an unexpected family tragedy. Now a mother, Lydia struggles with her complicated relationship with her rebellious teenage daughter, Astrid, who accidentally discovers a mysterious portal to the afterlife. When Astrid becomes trapped in the supernatural world, Lydia must confront her past and seek help from the mischievous ghost Beetlejuice, whose chaotic personality is just as unpredictable as ever. As strange creatures, dangerous spirits, and outrageous supernatural events take over, the family finds itself caught between the living and the dead. Starring Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega, and Catherine O’Hara, the film brings back the original’s signature dark humor, imaginative visuals, and unforgettable supernatural chaos.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Horror

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 45m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Tim Burton

✍️ Writers: Alfred Gough & Miles Millar

📺 Where to Watch: Check HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice (stylized on-screen as Beetlejuice Beetlejuice: 2024 A.D.) is a 2024 American dark fantasy comedy film directed and co-produced by Tim Burton, from a screenplay by Alfred Gough and Miles Millar. A sequel to Beetlejuice (1988), the film stars Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder and Catherine O'Hara reprising their roles, with Justin Theroux, Monica Bellucci, Jenna Ortega and Willem Dafoe joining the cast. Set more than three decades after the first film, it follows Lydia Deetz, now a mother, struggling to keep her family together in the wake of a loss as Betelgeuse returns to haunt her.
